integrity: Original model, Bernoulli property and established first-coordinate scalar statistics are credited as premises. Reproducibility script is finite diagnostic evidence and is not a proof of the infinite-domain result. Publication-priority risk from unindexed prior joint-coordinate studies remains.
scientific_limitations: Only centered affine coordinates under stationary normalized Lebesgue measure; fixed spatial dimension before the long-time limit; no extension claimed to nonlinear observables or other invariant measures. The all-dimension theorem uses an exact transfer identity and a standard bounded martingale limit theorem.
title: Dimension-free coordinate diffusion matrix for the twisted baker map
